correctness.rationale: Legal extension profiles are in bijection with complete nonalgebraic parameter types by homogeneity. The fiber argument has exactly one three-way fiber (type of v) and, for any comparable induced base, a distinct forced one-way fiber; summing gives t(Q)≤2t(P). Inducting from six extensions of the two-element chain gives the universal inequality. Independent transitive-closure enumeration verifies finite bounds and extremizers.

value.rationale: The type-space size over finite parameters is a natural model-theoretic invariant.
